# Urban Tales

> Urban Tales is a GPS audio guide app for iPhone and Android. As you walk through a city, it plays the hidden
> stories, history and legends of the landmarks around you, automatically, in English, Spanish, Portuguese,
> French or German. It works in any city worldwide, with no tour group, schedule or ticket.

- How it works: open the app and walk. Nearby landmarks appear on the map and their stories play as you get close
  (Pocket Mode keeps playing with the phone locked in your pocket). You can also build a walking tour of a city in
  seconds (7 Wonders, half day, full day or several days) and follow it with turn-by-turn directions.
- Free to start: 3 free stories a day. Unlimited listening with a Day Pass, a City Unlock or the annual Unlimited
  plan. Prices: https://urbantales.net/pricing.md
- Download: App Store https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760130598 · Google Play
  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.urbantales.app
- Made by Urban Tales (urbantales.net). Instagram and TikTok: @urbantalesapp. Contact: https://urbantales.net/contact.html

## Landmark guides

- [Plaza de Mayo history: Buenos Aires' main square | Urban Tales](https://urbantales.net/buenos-aires/plaza-de-mayo.html): Plaza de Mayo in plain words: why it's named after May 1810, the oldest monument in Buenos Aires, the Mothers' white scarves and what to look for. With an audio story.
- [Casa Rosada: why Argentina's presidential palace is pink | Urban Tales](https://urbantales.net/buenos-aires/casa-rosada.html): Why is the Casa Rosada pink? The fort it replaced, the colour under Sarmiento, the famous balcony and how to visit Argentina's presidential palace. With an audio story.
- [Caminito, La Boca: the story behind the colourful street | Urban Tales](https://urbantales.net/buenos-aires/caminito.html): Caminito in La Boca: the stream and railway it replaced, the painter who saved it, the tango it's named after and why the houses are so colourful. With an audio story.
- [Teatro Colón: history of Buenos Aires' great opera house | Urban Tales](https://urbantales.net/buenos-aires/teatro-colon.html): Teatro Colón history in plain words: the 20-year build, the opening with Aida in 1908, the famous acoustics and how to visit. With an audio story.
- [Obelisco de Buenos Aires: the story of the city's symbol | Urban Tales](https://urbantales.net/buenos-aires/obelisco.html): The Obelisco of Buenos Aires: why it was built in 1936, what it marks, how tall it is and what's inside. With an audio story.
- [Recoleta Cemetery: a city of the dead in Buenos Aires | Urban Tales](https://urbantales.net/buenos-aires/recoleta-cemetery.html): Recoleta Cemetery in plain words: why the rich moved here, Evita's grave, the legends and how to find your way. With an audio story.
- [Palacio Barolo: Buenos Aires' Divine Comedy building | Urban Tales](https://urbantales.net/buenos-aires/palacio-barolo.html): Palacio Barolo in plain words: the tallest building in South America in 1923, the lighthouse on top, the Dante legend and how to visit. With an audio story.
- [Café Tortoni: Buenos Aires' oldest café and its history | Urban Tales](https://urbantales.net/buenos-aires/cafe-tortoni.html): Café Tortoni in plain words: when it opened, its famous guests, the tango upstairs and what to look for. With an audio story.

With an audio story.
